mission: Say: (Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi wa ridha nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midada kalimatihi) (3 times)
earnings: Reward of those who remember Allah for long periods
details: Narrated by Ibn Abbas from Juwayriyah (may Allah be pleased with them) that the Prophet ﷺ left her in the morning after Fajr prayer while she was in her prayer area. When he returned later in the morning and found her still sitting, he asked, 'Have you been in the same state since I left you?' She replied, 'Yes.' The Prophet ﷺ said, 'I recited four words three times after leaving you, and if they were weighed against what you have recited today, they would outweigh them: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, 'adada khalqihi wa ridha nafsihi wa zinata 'arshihi wa midada kalimatihi.' (Muslim).
title: A small deed with great reward

mission: Read a letter or verse from the Quran
earnings: Ten rewards for every letter you read. For example, the approximate number of letters in Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas is 195 letters. 195 * 10 = 1,950 rewards.
details: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever reads a letter from the Book of Allah will receive one reward, and each reward is multiplied by ten. I do not say that Alif-Lam-Mim is one letter; rather, Alif is a letter, Lam is a letter, and Mim is a letter.' (Tirmidhi). Allah says: {Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times its like, and whoever comes with an evil deed will only be recompensed for it once, and they will not be wronged.} (Quran 6:160).
title: Reading the Quran

mission: Seek forgiveness for believing men and women
details: Narrated by Ubada ibn al-Samit (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Whoever seeks forgiveness for believing men and women, a reward will be recorded for him for every believing man and woman.' (Tabarani, authenticated by Al-Albani). The Quran says: {My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house as a believer and the believing men and women.} (Quran 71:28).
title: Seeking forgiveness for believers

mission: Say 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi' 100 times
details: Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever says Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi 100 times in a day will have his sins forgiven, even if they are as abundant as the foam of the sea.' (Bukhari). Allah says: {And the men and women who remember Allah often, Allah has prepared for them forgiveness and a great reward.} (Quran 33:35).
title: Saying 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi'

mission: Say: 'La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, Subhan Allah, wa al-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu akbar.'
details: Before sleeping, say: 'La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah, Subhan Allah, wa al-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu akbar.' If said sincerely, a person's sins will be forgiven, even if they are as abundant as the foam of the sea. (Nasa'i, Ibn Hibban, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Before sleeping

mission: Say: 'Astaghfirullah alladhi la ilaha illa huwa al-Hayyu al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh' (three times).
details: Narrated by Bilal ibn Yasar ibn Zayd, the freed slave of the Prophet ﷺ, from his father, from his grandfather, that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Whoever says: Astaghfirullah alladhi la ilaha illa huwa al-Hayyu al-Qayyum wa atubu ilayh (three times), his sins will be forgiven, even if he fled from battle.' (Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Seeking forgiveness

mission: Say 'Subhan Allah' 33 times, 'Alhamdulillah' 33 times, 'Allahu akbar' 33 times, then say: 'La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir.'
details: Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever glorifies Allah (says Subhan Allah) 33 times, praises Allah (says Alhamdulillah) 33 times, and declares Allah's greatness (says Allahu akbar) 33 times after each prayer, completing 99, and then says: La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as abundant as the foam of the sea.' (Muslim).
title: Tasbih, Tahmid, and Takbir

mission: Say: 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, Subhan Allah al-'Azim.'
earnings: Heavy rewards on the Day of Judgment
details: Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Two phrases are light on the tongue but heavy on the scales and beloved to the Most Merciful: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, Subhan Allah al-'Azim.' (Bukhari, Muslim). Allah says: {As for those whose scales are heavy, they will be in a pleasant life.} (Quran 101:6-7).
title: Saying 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi'

mission: Say: 'Alhamdulillah.'
earnings: Filling the scales on the Day of Judgment
details: Abu Malik al-Ash'ari (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Purity is half of faith, and Alhamdulillah fills the scales. Subhan Allah and Alhamdulillah fill what is between the heavens and the earth.' (Muslim). Allah says: {And the weighing on that Day is the truth. So those whose scales are heavy will be the successful.} (Quran 7:8).
title: Saying 'Alhamdulillah'

mission: Say: 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.'
earnings: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise
details: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Shall I guide you to a treasure from the treasures of Paradise? Say: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.' (Muslim).
title: Saying 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah'

mission: Send blessings on the Prophet ﷺ once.
earnings: 10 blessings from Allah + erasing 10 sins + elevation of 10 ranks.
details: Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever sends blessings on me once, Allah will send blessings on him tenfold, erase ten of his sins, and raise him ten ranks.' (Nasa'i, authenticated by Al-Albani). Allah says: {Indeed, Allah and His angels send blessings on the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings on him and greet him with peace.} (Quran 33:56).
title: Sending blessings on the Prophet

mission: Recite Ayat al-Kursi after every prayer.
details: Abu Umamah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise except death.' (Nasa'i, Tabarani, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Entering Paradise

mission: Say: 'Raditu billahi rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan, wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyyan.'
details: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever says: Raditu billahi rabban, wa bil-Islami dinan, wa bi-Muhammadin nabiyyan (I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad as my Prophet), Paradise will be guaranteed for him.' (Abu Dawud, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Guaranteed Paradise

mission: Say the Master of Supplications for Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar) during the day and night: 'Allahumma anta Rabbi, la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika ma-stata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bi-dhanbi, faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfiru al-dhunuba illa anta.'
earnings: Being granted the status of the people of Paradise
details: Shaddad ibn Aws (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'The Master of Supplications for Forgiveness is to say: Allahumma anta Rabbi, la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika ma-stata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bi-dhanbi, faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfiru al-dhunuba illa anta. Whoever says this during the day with firm belief and dies before evening, he will be among the people of Paradise. Whoever says it at night with firm belief and dies before morning, he will be among the people of Paradise.' (Bukhari).
time: A minute in the day and a minute at night
title: The Master of Supplications for Forgiveness

mission: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas (Qul huwa Allahu ahad) 10 times.
details: Mu'adh ibn Anas al-Juhani (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Whoever recites Qul huwa Allahu ahad ten times, Allah will build a palace for him in Paradise.' (Ahmad, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Surah Al-Ikhlas

mission: Speak good words.
details: Abdullah ibn Amr (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'In Paradise, there are rooms whose outside can be seen from the inside and vice versa.' It was asked, 'For whom are these, O Messenger of Allah?' He replied, 'For those who speak good words, feed others, and spend the night in prayer while others sleep.' (Ahmad, Bayhaqi, authenticated by Al-Albani). Allah says: {And those who believe and do righteous deeds, We will surely house them in lofty rooms of Paradise beneath which rivers flow.} (Quran 29:58).
title: Speaking good words

mission: Say: 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi.'
details: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Whoever says Subhan Allah al-'Azim wa bihamdihi, a palm tree will be planted for him in Paradise.' (Tirmidhi, authenticated by Al-Albani). Allah says: {So glorify the praises of your Lord and be among those who prostrate.} (Quran 15:98).
title: Saying 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi'

mission: Seek forgiveness for your parents.
earnings: Elevation of your parents' status in Paradise
details: Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'A person’s status in Paradise will be elevated, and he will ask, “How did I attain this?” It will be said, “Because of your child’s seeking forgiveness for you.”' (Ahmad, Ibn Majah, Bayhaqi, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Seeking forgiveness for parents

mission: Say: 'La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir' (100 times in a day).
earnings: Equivalent to freeing 10 slaves + 100 rewards + erasing 100 sins + protection from Satan throughout the day.
details: Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever says La ilaha illa Allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir 100 times in a day, it will be equivalent to freeing 10 slaves, 100 rewards will be recorded for him, 100 sins will be erased, and he will be protected from Satan for that day until evening. No one can achieve better than this except one who does more.' (Bukhari, Muslim).
title: Saying 'La ilaha illa Allah'

mission: Praise Allah after eating and drinking.
details: Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Allah is pleased with a servant who eats a meal and praises Him for it, or drinks a drink and praises Him for it.' (Muslim).
title: Praising Allah after eating

mission: Pray for your fellow Muslim in their absence.
earnings: An angel assigned to pray for you in return
details: Abu al-Darda (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever prays for his brother in his absence, an angel says, “Amen, and may you receive the same.”' (Muslim). Allah says: {And those who came after them say, “Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith.”} (Quran 59:10).
title: Praying in absence

mission: Ask Allah sincerely to grant you martyrdom.
earnings: Attaining the status of martyrs in Paradise, even if you die on your bed.
details: Sahl ibn Hunayf (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Whoever sincerely asks Allah for martyrdom, Allah will grant him the status of martyrs, even if he dies on his bed.' (Muslim).
title: Martyrdom

mission: Supplicate and seek forgiveness in the last third of the night.
earnings: Answered prayers, fulfillment of needs, and forgiveness of sins.
details: Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Our Lord descends to the lowest heaven in the last third of the night and says, “Who is calling upon Me that I may answer? Who is asking of Me that I may give? Who is seeking My forgiveness that I may forgive?”' (Bukhari, Muslim).
title: The last third of the night

mission: Recite Surah Al-Mulk (Tabarak alladhi bi-yadihi al-mulk...).
details: Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'A surah of the Quran containing thirty verses will intercede for a man until he is forgiven: Tabarak alladhi bi-yadihi al-mulk.' (Tirmidhi, Ahmad, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Surah Al-Mulk

mission: Glorify Allah (say 'Subhan Allah') 100 times.
details: Mus'ab ibn Sa'd reported from his father that they were with the Messenger of Allah ﷺ when he said, 'Is anyone of you incapable of earning 1,000 rewards every day?' Someone asked, 'How can one earn 1,000 rewards?' The Prophet ﷺ replied, 'By glorifying Allah (saying Subhan Allah) 100 times, for which 1,000 rewards are recorded or 1,000 sins are erased.' (Muslim).
title: Glorifying Allah

mission: Say: 'Bismillah alladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fi al-ardi wa la fi al-sama'i wa huwa al-Sami' al-'Alim' (three times in the morning and evening).
details: Uthman ibn Affan (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Whoever says in the evening: Bismillah alladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fi al-ardi wa la fi al-sama'i wa huwa al-Sami' al-'Alim (three times), he will not be afflicted by sudden calamity until morning. Whoever says it in the morning (three times), he will not be afflicted by sudden calamity until evening.' (Abu Dawud, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Saying 'Bismillah alladhi la yadurru...'

mission: Recite Surah Al-Kahf on Friday.
details: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever recites Surah Al-Kahf on Friday, a light will shine for him between the two Fridays.' (Hakim, Bayhaqi, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: Reciting Surah Al-Kahf

mission: Say after hearing the Adhan: 'Allahumma rabba hadhihi al-da'wah al-tammah wa al-salat al-qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilah wa al-fadilah, wa ab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtahu.'
details: Jabir ibn Abdullah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Whoever says after hearing the Adhan: Allahumma rabba hadhihi al-da'wah al-tammah wa al-salat al-qa'imah, ati Muhammadan al-wasilah wa al-fadilah, wa ab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtahu, my intercession will be granted to him on the Day of Judgment.' (Bukhari).
title: Supplication after Adhan

mission: Say: 'Subhan Allah, wa al-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu akbar.'
earnings: Subhan Allah: 20 rewards and erasure of 20 sins. Allahu akbar: 20 rewards and erasure of 20 sins. La ilaha illa Allah: 20 rewards and erasure of 20 sins. Alhamdulillah rabb al-'alamin: 30 rewards and erasure of 30 sins.
details: Abu Huraira and Abu Sa'id (may Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Prophet ﷺ said, 'Allah has chosen four phrases: Subhan Allah, wa al-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu akbar. Whoever says Subhan Allah, 20 rewards are recorded for him and 20 sins are erased. Whoever says Allahu akbar, the same applies. Whoever says La ilaha illa Allah, the same applies. Whoever says Alhamdulillah rabb al-'alamin from his heart, 30 rewards are recorded for him and 30 sins are erased.' (Ahmad, authenticated by Al-Albani).
title: The four chosen phrases
